Variants.Content: New Gith is located on an island south of Slaver's Bay. It is a city-state established by the descendants of Ancient Gith. It shares the Ghiscari language, dress, and traditions of slavery with the Astapor, Yunkai, and Meereen, yet maintains its independence through fleets and sea routes; its location connects Slaver's Bay to the Jade Sea Route further east.

Entry New Ghis If you can supply supplies, avoid danger, and find a guide, it is worth marking in your itinerary; if you don't have these three things, no matter how loud your family name is, it won't be able to save the lost.

New Ghis is not just the main hall of the city; the stone walls, wooden beams, iron doors, tombs and seams left by generations of repairs are also shaped here by the gods of Qarth, the memory of the merchant king and the burial customs in the wasteland. A stronghold was therefore not just a lord's hall, but also a place where weddings and funerals, vows, labor and local memories recurred.

Entry New Ghis They care about water wells, camel caravans, spices and supplies across the red wasteland. They also look at whether seeds are left behind after collecting grain and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see coats of arms, what they see is whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
